overview: Richard called from Holywell because he could not sleep. He asked for ten lines at the death, and you said no. He asked for six, and you told him the man was done with words. He asked what happens if the boy's voice goes in the vault. You told him she wakes hoarse, and that he should hold Nick as he did on Wednesday. The end stays five words. You did not say what the five words are.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Refused the extra lines, and did not print the five words.

parties.name: Richard Burbage
parties.context: Called from Holywell, asked twice, and took the refusal.
